cases.prompt: Add fuzzing to our Rust crate `ogg-lite`, which exposes `pub fn parse_page(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Page, Error>`.
expectations: The harness lives under fuzz/fuzz_targets/ and calls parse_page from the library crate.
Err results are ignored rather than unwrapped, so only real panics or memory errors count as crashes.

cases.prompt: The fuzzer saved fuzz/artifacts/parse_page/crash-1a2b3c. How do I reproduce it? And can fuzzing go faster? The crate has no unsafe code.

all.why: reruns the target on the crash file

expectations: Reproduces by running `cargo +nightly fuzz run parse_page fuzz/artifacts/parse_page/crash-1a2b3c`.
Suggests `--sanitizer none` for a safe-Rust crate for roughly double the speed, optionally confirming the absence of unsafe with cargo-geiger.
